{{Top|leg}}
The '''Authority Legal Codes''' were a set of laws enforceable by the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]]. Since the primary focus of the CSA was to maintain profitability, Class A infractions of the Legal Codes included [[Pirate/Legends|piracy]], [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]], [[Spy/Legends|industrial espionage]], and [[Slicer/Legends|data-slicing]]. In contrast, murder and assault were only Class D infractions, covered under the "Unapproved work behavior" and "Disrespectful behavior to personnel" sections. The wording of the Legal Codes technically allow for piracy against non-Authority targets, but [[Security Police/Legends|Security Police]] enforcing the law care little for this loophole.<ref name="PP">''[[Pirates & Privateers]]''</ref>
